title: CodeEdit highlights brace pairs even when removed from auto_brace_completion_pairs
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in: v4.6.3.stable.arch_linux [35e80b3a8]

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable (35e80b3a8) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 23 May 2026 14:21:20 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

The documentation for [CodeEdit.auto_brace_completion_highlight_matching](https://docs.godotengine.org/de/4.x/classes/class_codeedit.html#class-codeedit-property-auto-brace-completion-highlight-matching) states: "If true, highlights brace pairs when the caret is on either one, using auto_brace_completion_pairs."

Manually changing `auto_brace_completion_pairs`, for example to an empty dictionary, correctly disables brace completion, but matching braces are still highlighted.

### Steps to reproduce

Use the attached project or just make a new project with a single CodeEdit in it and use the following code:
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	$CodeEdit.auto_brace_completion_pairs = { }
	$CodeEdit.auto_brace_completion_enabled = true
	$CodeEdit.auto_brace_completion_highlight_matching = true
```
Open the project and type "{}" into the CodeEdit. You will see the braces being highlighted.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[code-edit-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28682656/code-edit-bug.zip)

### Additional information

This works in both directions — newly added brace pairs are autocompleted but not highlighted.
